title: High loan-to-income mortgages rise to 46% of advances
summary:
Nearly half of all mortgage advances in the second quarter went to borrowers with high loan-to-income ratios, according to FCA and Bank of England data. The 46% figure represents an increase from 41.4% a year earlier, raising concerns about long-term affordability.

title: Property viewings decline 57% as buyer-seller gap widens
summary:
The average number of viewings per property for sale has dropped to 1.7, down from nearly four viewings two years ago, according to Propertymark data. The report revealed that 86% of estate agents reported properties achieving less than the asking price.

title: Buy-to-let yields reach highest level since 2011
summary:
Buy-to-let yields in the UK have reached their highest level in 15 years at 7.22%, according to Paragon Bank's Q3 2026 report. The East Midlands generated the highest regional yield at 8.1%, while London recorded the lowest at 5.79%.

title: London landlords re-let properties after initial sale plans
summary:
Approximately one in four London landlords who listed properties for sale following the implementation of the Renters' Rights Act have since returned them to the rental market. The estate agency's analysis indicates that rising rental yields have encouraged property owners to reverse their decision to exit the buy-to-let sector.

title: Government retains £2m mansion tax threshold
summary:
The Government has reportedly abandoned plans to reduce the threshold for the High Value Council Tax Surcharge from £2 million to £1.5 million. The decision means nearly one in 10 London homes currently for sale will avoid the tax.

The post Government retains £2m mansion tax threshold appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Government proposes six-month threshold for empty home orders
summary:
The UK government has announced plans to reduce the qualifying period for Empty Dwelling Management Orders from two years to six months, enabling councils to take over management of vacant properties. The proposal has generated debate within the property sector about balancing housing supply needs against property ownership rights.

The post Government proposes six-month threshold for empty home orders appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Property ombudsman calls for integrated regulation system
summary:
The Property Ombudsman has outlined the need for closer integration between regulation and redress mechanisms as the government prepares to introduce independent regulation of property agents in the UK. Chief ombudsman Lesley Horton stated that whilst regulation presents opportunities to drive sector improvements, it must work alongside redress providers to deliver meaningful consumer protection.

title: UK rental prices fall across most regions in September
summary:
Rental prices declined across all but one region in England, Wales and Scotland during September, according to data released by Propertymark. Scotland recorded the largest monthly decrease at 3.4%, bringing average rents to £1,134.

The post UK rental prices fall across most regions in September appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Unite Group lowers student rents for first time in 25 years
summary:
Unite Group has reduced student rents by 0.3% for the current academic year, the first decline in over 25 years outside of Covid-19. The UK's largest student accommodation provider cited falling international student numbers and more British students living at home as key factors.

title: Connells Group reports progress on branch refurbishment programme
summary:
Connells Group has completed or neared completion on 38 branch refurbishments as part of its ongoing estate modernisation programme, with a further 50 branches scheduled for upgrades in 2027. The estate agency group operates approximately 1,200 branches across 87 brands.
